user.title: TankPuls
user.description: Optional API key (format `ID|Secret`). Without a key the anonymous per-IP limits apply, which are usually sufficient for Home Assistant. The free Community plan (30 requests/min, 10,000/month) is often *worse* than anonymous.

location.title: Find stations
location.description: Search by position and radius (max. 50 km) or, if filled in, by postal code.

reconfigure.title: Change API key
reconfigure.description: Leave empty to use the API anonymously.

error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to the TankPuls API.
error.invalid_key: TankPuls does not accept this API key. Check the format or leave the field empty.
error.no_stations: No stations found. Increase the radius or pick another location.

error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to the TankPuls API.

invalid_api_key.title: TankPuls API key is not accepted

confirm.title: Replace or remove the API key
confirm.description: TankPuls reports key status `{status}`. Requests continue anonymously. Enter a new key or clear the field to continue without one.

confirm.title: Remove station
confirm.description: {station} was decommissioned or is unknown. Confirming removes the station including its device and entities.

stale_data.title: No recent price reports
stale_data.description: No station has reported a new price for more than {hours} hours during the day. The data source (MTS-K via Tankerkönig) may be serving stale prices.
